correctness.rationale: For Euclidean projection onto the same convex-sequence cone, strict KKT construction realizes all second-difference active-face projectors P_A and polyhedral integration reduces its global Gini modulus to the largest local one. Since P_A fixes constants and Gini variation is additive on sorted-level binary-cut decompositions, the exact formula is max_A max_nontrivial_S G(P_A1_S)/(|S|(n-|S|)). Fresh exact rational enumeration of all active faces and complementary cuts independently reproduced n=2..8 values 1,1,10/9,41/35,213/175,191/153,463/357; the last size separately rechecked. The first-active-curvature projector sends e_1 to (5/6,1/3,-1/6,0,...) and gives the exact all-n lower bound (4n-6)/(3(n-1))>1 for n>=4. Explicit four-site strictly complementary KKT inputs realize 10/9. Does not prove sharp larger-size constants.
residual_risks: Exact Lambda_n only through eight; all-dimensional bound may not be sharp.
